stem: Carlo is appointed to a permanent position and assumes office on August 3, 2026. Under Section 8(A) of RA 6713, when must he file his FIRST SALN?
choices: On or before April 30 of the next year
Within 60 days after he assumes office
Within 15 working days after he assumes office
Within 30 days after he assumes office
answer: Within 30 days after he assumes office
hints: The question asks for his FIRST SALN. Section 8(A) has a separate deadline for people who are just starting.
Section 8(A) lists three deadlines: one counted from assumption of office, one fixed date every year, and one counted from separation from the service.
The yearly date is for "every year thereafter," which means after the first filing. Use the deadline counted from assumption of office, and recall its number of days.

solution.methodName: Match each number to its rule

steps.action: Read the three deadlines in Section 8(A): "(a) within thirty (30) days after assumption of office; (b) on or before April 30, of every year thereafter; and (c) within thirty (30) days after separation from the service."
Carlo is just starting, so deadline (a) applies to his first SALN.
steps.why: Assumption of office means the day he starts holding the post.
"Thereafter" means after that. The April 30 deadline applies every year after the first filing.

steps.action: Check that he must file at all: Section 8(A) exempts only "those who serve in an honorary capacity, laborers and casual or temporary workers." Carlo holds a permanent position, so he must file.
The answer is: Within 30 days after he assumes office.

trapNotes.On or before April 30 of the next year: April 30 is the yearly deadline "of every year thereafter," meaning after the first filing. His first SALN is due within 30 days after assumption of office.
trapNotes.Within 60 days after he assumes office: 60 days is the Section 9 deadline for divesting shares when there is a conflict of interest. The first SALN is due within 30 days.
trapNotes.Within 15 working days after he assumes: 15 working days is the deadline for answering letters from the public (Section 5(a)), not for the SALN.
